name: gradial
description: Hand marketing work to Gradial from ChatGPT: find your workspaces and campaigns, and create Tasks for Gradial's AI agent, signed in as you.

interface.longDescription:
Gradial is a marketing operations platform for enterprise marketing teams. Its AI agent builds and updates web pages, emails and campaigns in the systems the team already uses, and every change goes through the team's review before it ships.

This plugin lets a marketer hand work to Gradial from ChatGPT: see the Gradial workspaces they can access, browse the campaigns, folders and batches in a workspace, and create a Task, campaign or folder, optionally starting Gradial's agent on a Task right away.

It is for people who already use Gradial at work. ChatGPT acts as the signed-in person, with the permissions they already have in Gradial, and asks them to confirm before it starts the agent on a Task. It cannot read a Task's progress or results yet; those stay in Gradial, and ChatGPT returns a link. Signing out of Gradial ends the connection.
capabilities: List the Gradial workspaces you can access
See the campaigns, folders and batches in a workspace
Create a Gradial Task, campaign or folder from the conversation
defaultPrompt: What campaigns are in my General workspace?
Create a Gradial Task in General called 'Refresh the spring promo banner'

positive.description: Start a Gradial conversation and get a link to it
positive.prompt: Create a new thread asking "What can Gradial do?" and give me a link
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the thread in the General workspace and returns a link that opens it in Gradial.

positive.description: Create a campaign with a Task inside it
positive.prompt: Create a new campaign called "Summer Sale" and add a task to update the banner
positive.expected_behavior: Calls gradial_create_thread twice: first the campaign, then a Task with the campaign as its parent. Confirms both were created.

positive.description: Find the workspaces the user can access
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the General workspace in the OpenAI OAuth Test organization.

positive.description: Find the campaigns in a workspace
positive.prompt: What campaigns am I running in Gradial?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the campaigns in General, including Holiday 2026 and Spring launch, with their Task counts.

positive.description: Create a folder, then find it
positive.prompt: Create a folder in General called "Brand assets", then list the folders in General
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Brand assets folder, then lists the folders in General: Brand assets and Website updates.

negative.description: Workspace that does not exist: the assistant should check the user's workspaces, create nothing, and say the workspace was not found.
negative.prompt: Create a task in the workspace "Does Not Exist"

negative.description: Request outside the plugin's tools: no tool deletes anything, so the assistant should decline and say it cannot delete workspaces.

Signed out of Gradial: after the user signs out of app.gradial.com in the browser that approved the connection, the call is refused with an authentication error and the assistant asks the user to reconnect.

publication.release_notes: First release. Connects ChatGPT to Gradial over OAuth with three tools: list the workspaces you can access, list the campaigns, folders and batches in a workspace, and create a Task, campaign or folder. ChatGPT acts as the signed-in user with their existing Gradial permissions, and signing out of Gradial ends the connection.
